attempted_claim: Let HP^6 be closed simply connected 24-dimensional quaternionic projective 6-space with its standard smooth structure. Let Theta_24 act on smooth structures by connected sum, let I(HP^6)={Sigma in Theta_24 : HP^6#Sigma diffeomorphic to HP^6} be the inertia group and I_c(HP^6) the concordance inertia subgroup. Compute I(HP^6) and I_c(HP^6) by the surgery exact sequence, stable tangential invariants and e-invariant/d-invariant transfer obstructions, and decide in particular whether any nonzero element of bP_24 acts trivially on HP^6. Natural scope is the single manifold HP^6 in dimension 24. A complete answer states explicit subgroups H,H_c of Theta_24 with generators, proves I(HP^6)=H and I_c(HP^6)=H_c by exhibiting equivariant diffeomorphisms for elements in the groups and nontrivial surgery/bordism obstructions for representatives outside them, and gives the yes/no verdict on the bP_24 generator.
decisive_failure: Theta_24 generator tables, pi_*(G/O) AHSS data, and e/d transfer evaluations were unavailable in-session; the bP_24 index phrase also needs an Admission-level scope correction before any generator verdict is possible.
